content: राहुः [रह्-उण् <ls>Uṇ. 1. 3</ls>] .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a demon, son of Viprachitti and Siṃhikā and hence often called {%Saimhikeya%}; ग्रसते हि तमोपहं मुहुर्ननु राह्वाह्वमहर्पतिं तमः <ls>Śi. 16. 57</ls>; विधुरपि विधियोगाद् ग्रस्यते राहुणासौ <ls>H.</ls> [When the nectar, that was churned out of the ocean, was being served to the gods, Rāhu disguised himself and attempted to drink it along with them. But he was detected by the sun and the moon who informed Viṣṇu of the fraud. Viṣṇu, thereupon, severed his head from the body; but as he had tasted a little quantity of nectar the head became immortal, and is supposed to wreak its vengeance on the sun and moon at the time of conjunction and opposition; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Bh. 2. 34</ls>. In astronomy Rāhu is regarded, like Ketu, as one of the nine planets, or only as the ascending node of the moon.] .²2 An eclipse, or rather the moment of occultation. .²3 Abandoning. .²4 One who abandons. .²5 The regent of the south-west quarter.
